lunch-buffet.title: Lunch Buffet in Stockholm
lunch-buffet.content:
Lunchbuffé i Stockholm

Stockholm’s Best Value Workday Lunch Buffet

Escape the office and upgrade your lunch break! Located conveniently near the Spånga industrial area, Anmol Sweets & Restaurant offers the perfect solution for a fast, delicious, and satisfying workday meal. Our generous Indian & Pakistani lunch buffet is designed for busy professionals who want real food and great value, without the long wait.

Book Your Table
Upload Image...

Anmol Lunch Buffet – All You Need to Know

  • Price: 139 SEK
  • Time: Monday – Friday, 11:00 AM – 2:00 PM (11:00 – 14:00)
  • Includes: Indo Pak Classic dishes with daily rotation.
  • Location: Anmol Sweets & Restaurant, Fagerstagatan 13, Spånga, Stockholm

A Taste of the Subcontinent – In the Heart of Spånga

Forget boring packed lunches. At Anmol, you get a complete, satisfying meal where every dish tells a story. Our lunch buffet is designed to offer a perfect balance of flavours, from mild and creamy curries to more robust and spicy options. It’s the perfect opportunity to sample several of our signature dishes and find new favourites, all prepared with the care and quality you expect from Anmol.

Book Your Table Now


The Smart Choice for Your Lunch Break

We understand that your lunch break is valuable. Our buffet is set up to provide a premium-quality meal with maximum efficiency, making us the ideal choice for local workers and businesses.

  • Great Value: For just 139 SEK, you get an all-you-can-eat meal including hot dishes, salad, bread, coffee, and dessert. It’s a full, satisfying meal that won’t break your budget.

  • Fast & Convenient: No waiting to order or for your food to be cooked. Simply come in, choose from the wide selection on the buffet, and enjoy your meal immediately. You can be back at your desk, energized and on time.

  • Something for Everyone: Our daily rotation ensures there’s always something new to try, with a guaranteed balance of meat and vegetarian options to satisfy everyone on your team.

  • Expert Reasoning: This section directly addresses the three core needs of a working lunch customer: Value, Speed, and Variety. It explicitly tells them why Anmol is the logical and best choice for their daily lunch. It’s not just food; it’s a solution to their lunchtime problem.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.content:
Bookings at Anmol Sweets & Restaurant

Planning a visit to enjoy our authentic Indo-Pak cuisine? Book your table now and ensure a seamless dining experience! Whether it’s a family gathering, a special celebration, or a casual meal, we’re here to make your time with us memorable.

Contact Us:

For large group bookings, private events, or any questions, feel free to call us at

+46 8 88 66 79 | +46 76 917 84 56 or visit us at
Fagerstagatan 13, Spånga, Sweden

 

Why Book with Us?

  • Guaranteed Seating: Avoid waiting and secure your spot in advance.

  • Special Requests: Let us know if you have any dietary preferences or need arrangements for special occasions.

  • Exclusive Offers: Be the first to know about our seasonal promotions and discounts.

How to Book:

  1. Fill out the form below with your details.

  2. Select your preferred date, time, and party size.

  3. Add any special requests or notes in the comments section.

  4. Hit Submit, and we’ll confirm your reservation shortly!

Reserve Your Table


Walk-Ins Welcome!

If you’re spontaneous, don’t worry – we always keep some tables open for walk-in guests. However, booking in advance is recommended, especially during weekends and holidays.

Contact Us:

For large group bookings, private events, or any questions, feel free to call us at

+46 8 88 66 79 | +46 76 917 84 56 or visit us at

Special Orders | Catering Services in Stockholm

Stockholm’s Catering Partner for Pakistani & Indian Cuisine

Anmol Sweets & Restaurant elevates your Stockholm events with exceptional catering services designed to impress. Whether you’re planning an intimate gathering, a grand wedding, or a corporate luncheon, we create a customized culinary experience that reflects your vision and delights your guests.

More Than Just Food: We Craft Memories

Our passion lies in serving authentic Pakistani & Indian cuisine, bursting with vibrant flavors and prepared using only the freshest ingredients. From succulent curries and fluffy rice (Biryani) to flavorful vegetarian dishes and melt-in-your-mouth desserts, our extensive menu caters to all dietary preferences.

Catering Services for Every Occasion:

  • Weddings: Celebrate your love story with a feast fit for royalty. Our customized wedding catering packages create unforgettable memories for you and your guests.
  • Corporate Events: Impress colleagues and clients with our professional and delicious catering. We offer breakfast meetings, lunch buffets, conference catering, and more.
  • Social Gatherings: Elevate your next party or get-together with our diverse catering options. Appetizers, main courses, and decadent desserts – we have it all!
  • Special Occasions: Birthdays, anniversaries, graduations – let Anmol Sweets & Restaurant cater to your special moments with unforgettable culinary experiences.

A Culinary Journey Awaits: Explore Our Diverse Catering Menu.

At Anmol Sweets & Restaurant, we believe that food has the power to bring people together. That’s why we offer a wide variety of Indian, Pakistani, and fusion specialties on our catering menu. From classic curries and aromatic biryanis to innovative fusion dishes, we cater to all palates and dietary needs.

Freshness & Quality: The Cornerstones of Our Cuisine

We are passionate about using only the freshest and highest-quality ingredients. This dedication translates into dishes that are not just visually appealing but also bursting with authentic flavor.

 

Flexibility is key! Our diverse menu allows you to customize your catering experience perfectly. We work closely with you to create a menu that reflects your vision, considering your guests’ preferences and any dietary restrictions.

Stress-Free Events: Our Promise to You

At Anmol Sweets & Restaurant, we are dedicated to making your event a success. We offer exceptional customer service and handle everything from setup and service to cleanup. Rest assured, you can sit back, relax, and enjoy your special occasion while your guests experience a culinary journey they won’t forget.

Tailored Menus: Reflect Your Vision

 

Why Choose Anmol Sweets & Restaurant Catering?

 

  • Diverse & Delicious Menu: Authentic Indian & Pakistani cuisines alongside creative fusion dishes.
  • Freshness & Quality: We prioritize using the finest ingredients for exceptional flavor.
  • Customization: We work with you to create a menu that reflects your vision and dietary needs.
  • Full-Service Catering: We handle everything, ensuring a stress-free event for you.

Ready to Create Unforgettable Memories?

Contact us today to discuss your catering needs and explore our diverse menu options. We’ll help you craft a culinary experience that delights your guests and leaves a lasting impression.

 

From Weddings to Work Lunches: Anmol Sweets Catering Services, Stockholm

 

 

Contact us for Catering and bulk orders

Call : +46 8 88 66 79

Call | Whatsapp : +46 76 917 84 56

Visit : Fagerstagatan 13 163 53 Spånga, Sweden.

Facebook: AnmolSweetsStockholm

Instagram: @anmolsweetsstockholm

 

Beyond the Plate: Unmatched Service & Flexibility

  • Live Cooking: Transform your event with our live cooking experience! Witness our skilled chefs prepare your chosen dishes fresh on-site, adding an interactive and engaging element to your gathering.
  • No Minimum Order: We cater to events of all sizes, offering customization to fit your needs.
  • Bulk Orders: We also cater to bulk orders for larger gatherings.
  • Full-Service Catering: From menu planning to setup, execution, and cleanup, we handle everything. You just relax and enjoy your event.
  • Delivery & Pickup: Choose between convenient delivery to your event location or pickup from our Stockholm restaurant.

Anmol Sweets & Restaurant has proudly served Stockholm for over 4 years, consistently ranked No. 1 for Subcontinental food catering services.

An Award-Winning Culinary Journey:

 

Let’s Exceed Your Expectations!

 

Contact us today to discuss your catering needs and receive a personalized quote. Together, we’ll create a culinary experience that exceeds your expectations and makes your event truly memorable.

about.title: About us
about.content:
About Us

Anmol Sweets & Restaurant

 

 

 

Experience the Best of Pakistani & Indian Cuisine at Anmol Sweets & Restaurant Stockholm

Welcome to Anmol Sweets & Restaurant, where you’ll find the best in Pakistani and Indian cuisine in Stockholm. Our focus is on providing premium quality food made with the freshest and finest ingredients. We take pride in our high standards for quality and customer service, ensuring that every meal you enjoy with us is nothing short of exceptional.

A Commitment to Quality and Affordability

At Anmol Sweets & Restaurant, we believe that everyone deserves access to delicious, high-quality food. That’s why we strive to deliver the best food at the most affordable prices, making it accessible to everyone, no matter where you are. Our team works tirelessly to inspect the quality of our ingredients and ensure that only the best products make it to your table.

Enjoy Delicious Cuisine in a Welcoming Atmosphere

We understand that food is a social experience, and that’s why we’ve created a warm and inviting atmosphere where you can enjoy a meal with friends and family. Whether you’re looking for classic Indian sweets, savory desi nashta, or a full-course meal, we have something to suit every taste.

The Best-Rated Restaurant in Stockholm

Our commitment to quality and customer service has earned us an outstanding reputation in Stockholm. With an average rating of 4.2 and 475 Google reviews, we are proud to be the best-rated restaurant in the city. And according to 470 votes, we’re the number one restaurant in Sluurpy, with an 89% rating. So why not come and experience the best of Pakistani and Indian cuisine for yourself?

At Anmol Sweets & Restaurant, we look forward to welcoming you to our table and sharing the best of Pakistani and Indian cuisine with you.

Our Branch Locations.

Anmol Sweets & Restaurant – Bringing the Flavors of Subcontinent to Stockholm

At Anmol Sweets & Restaurant, we are dedicated to bringing the rich flavors and diverse culinary traditions of Indo Pak to Stockholm. Our menu features a wide range of traditional and fusion dishes, made with the freshest ingredients and authentic spices. Whether you’re a fan of classic subcontinental dishes or looking to try something new, we have something to suit every taste.

A Long-Standing Tradition of Quality and Excellence

With over 10 in the restaurant industry, our team has a deep-rooted passion for Pakistani cuisine and a commitment to quality. We believe that food should not only taste great, but also bring people together. That’s why we strive to create an inviting and warm atmosphere, where our guests can enjoy a delicious meal in good company.

A Focus on Fresh, Healthy Ingredients

At Anmol Sweets & Restaurant, we believe in using the freshest ingredients and authentic spices to create delicious and healthy meals. Our dishes are made from scratch, using locally sourced ingredients whenever possible, to ensure the highest quality and flavor. Whether you’re in the mood for a classic dish or something new and adventurous, we have something to suit every palate.

A Place for Everyone

We believe that everyone deserves a chance to enjoy the rich flavors and diverse culinary traditions of India, and that’s why we’ve made our restaurant a place for everyone. Whether you’re dining alone, with friends, or with family, we welcome you with open arms. So why not come and visit us today and taste the difference for yourself?

At Anmol Sweets & Restaurant, we’re proud to bring the flavors of Pakistan & India to Stockholm, and we look forward to welcoming you to our table soon!
